headline: School Committee to vote on several policy updates and hear Northeast Metro Tech and Superintendent's reports.
summary: The meeting covers updates on Northeast Metro Tech, the Superintendent's report on DESE accountability results, enrollment, and technology, and votes on multiple school policy revisions. The committee will also meet in executive session to discuss contract negotiations with the Malden Education Association.
items: Consent Agenda: Approval of August 31, 2026 School Committee Meeting Minutes
Consent Agenda: September 2026 Warrants
Consent Agenda: September 2026 Grants
Update from Northeast Metro Tech
Public Comment
Superintendent's Report: 2026 DESE Accountability Results
Superintendent's Report: Enrollment Snapshot
Superintendent's Report: Technology Updates
Policy Subcommittee Report and Discussion on Policy AD (Mission Statement)
Motion to adopt revised wording for Policy AA (School District Legal Status)
Motion to adopt updated MASC policy for Policy ACA (Nondiscrimination on the Basis of Sex)
Motion to adopt updated MASC policy and rename Policy ACE to 'Nondiscrimination on the Basis of Disability'
Motion to adopt updated policy and rename Policy ADC to 'Tobacco Products on School Premises Prohibited'
Motion to retire Policy ADDA-R-1 (C.O.R.I. requirements)
Motion to adopt updated coding of Policy ADDA-R-2 to ADDA-R (DCJIS Model CORI Policy)
Motion to adopt new language for Policy JA-G and rename it to 'Policy ACL: Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act)'
Motion to refer Policy JEB (Entrance Age) to Policy Subcommittee
Personal Privilege
Executive Session: Approval of August 31, 2026 Executive Session Meeting Minutes
Executive Session: Contract Negotiations with Malden Education Association, Units A, B & C
